verdict.rationale: HubSpot's docs show contacts and companies as first-class CRM records. Imports can create associations between companies, deals and activities such as calls and meetings, and connected inboxes log email replies to the CRM. This supports linked records with logged activities, but nothing explicitly describes a per-record activity timeline view. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a full activity timeline on contact and company records, direct docs on managing contact–company associations in the UI, independent or hands-on corroboration.
